RayCastIsosurface - VTK
Description This examples show how volume rendering can produce isosurface-like images. Using vtkOpenGLGPUVolumeRayCastMapper with an isosurface blend mode, two isosurfaces are created using appropriate transfer functions. The effect is similar to what is shown in MedicalDemo2. The user can specify the .mhd file and the two isosurface values.
